label: Vertices of a layered grid
subgoals: Place one vertex per track intersection per layer
Multiply columns, rows and layers to count vertices
Remove or penalize vertices on blockages

label: Preferred directions and wire edges
subgoals: Alternate horizontal and vertical directions by layer
Count wire edges along each layer's preferred direction
Sum the horizontal and vertical layer counts

label: Vias and edge costs
subgoals: Add one via edge per point between each pair of adjacent layers
Sum wire and via edges for the total
Encode wirelength, via, congestion and history costs on the edges
